::: {.section-eyebrow style="margin-top:2.6rem"}
What you'll run it on
:::

A **bite-size slice** of the real study — the first 10,000 read pairs from each of 36
sink-drain samples. Small enough to download in seconds and run on a laptop, yet
enough to see every step work for real. The final analysis then uses the
**full-depth results** (shipped with the repo), because that's where the biology
actually shows up.

New here? Start with the [**Overview**](overview.qmd) for the story behind the data,
or jump straight to [**Setup**](setup.qmd).

:::
